mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the absolute level of the rate.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as measured by the concurrent rise in both series.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns are not positive in 60% of instances where both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicate strong consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as housing is a leading indicator of economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return in high-housing-starts periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 240 signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) consistently indicates a healthy labor market that supports consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return in high-employment-growth periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
